description: Contextual high-density residential district. Quality Housing mandatory. Allows tall buildings with FAR up to 7.52 (9.02 qualifying). Common in Manhattan and high-density outer borough areas.

bulk.far_note: UAP standard. High FAR — significant development potential. Community facility FAR per ZR §24-11.

height_setback.street_wall_setback_wide_st: 10 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_setback_narrow_st: 15 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_location: No closer than buildings within 150 ft on same block
height_setback.notes: Per ZR §23-432 table (R9A1, R9-1 rows). R9A2 / R9-2: min base 60, max base 95, max height 135 ft standard. Qualifying extends to 185 ft. Tower regulations §23-435 do not apply in contextual R9A.

side.requirement: Per §23-335: none required for Quality Housing contextual

rear.through_lot_alternative: Rear yard equivalent per §23-343 on through lots ≥180 ft

permitted_uses.parking: Parking not permitted in front yard
